bias_targets.methodology: Grammar-based generation of equivalent test sentences with counterfactual substitution of male/female pronouns and gendered names, evaluated using metamorphic oracles for individual fairness and median absolute deviation (MAD) for group fairness across coreference resolution, masked language modeling, and sentiment analysis tasks.

Grammar-based generation of test sentences using counterfactual substitution of racially associated names (e.g., African-American vs. European names), evaluated using metamorphic oracles to measure changes in model outputs for sentiment analysis.

Grammar-based generation of test inputs with counterfactual substitution of religious identities (e.g., Christian vs. Hindu), evaluated using metamorphic oracles to check for individual fairness violations in coreference resolution.

Grammar-based generation of test inputs with counterfactual substitution of occupational terms (e.g., CEO vs. cleaner), evaluated to detect individual fairness violations (via metamorphic oracles) and representational group fairness violations (via anomaly detection) across multiple NLP tasks.
